linda: quick heads-up - targeting a late-night partial-index migration + backfill during the maintenance slot 23:30-00:15 UTC. want a brief coord thread for image pin, canary scope, and rollback escape hatch.

deploybot: maintenance window reserved: 2024-05-22 23:30 -> 00:15 UTC. job id: partial_index_add_v2. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/partial-index-v2 :white_check_mark:

mel: what exactly is "partial" here? does it create a new index concurrently or swap? we need to avoid long-lived locks on writes.

frank: implementation creates a new partial index on tenant_events filtered by event_type != 'heartbeat', then atomically swaps names using ALTER INDEX ... RENAME. the rename is quick but requires an exclusive metadata lock for ~100ms.

db-admin: note: some replicas show occasional schema-apply delays under heavy write load; ops-bot preflight will verify replica lag <50ms before starting.

ops-bot: preflight checks queued: replica_lag < 50ms, disk_io_util < 70%, migration_tests: pass. will post results 30m before start.

linda: canary plan: sample tenant ranges 5-7 only (approx 2% traffic). manual unpause after first 5 shards. if any errors, auto-abort and run escape-hatch.

mel: rollback criteria proposal: abort if (1) DDL metadata lock >500ms observed, (2) write retries >1% for 3 consecutive minutes, or (3) temp index >10GB on any node.

deploybot: canary configured: sample_shards=[5,6,7], pause_after=5 shards, ramp: 2->100% over 8min if unpaused. abort thresholds set to mel's proposal.

frank: ops request: pin migration-runner image to sha256:def456 and the schema-migration tool to sha256:987fed. also lock feature flag `enable_partial_index_v2` OFF until canary unpaused.

ops-bot: image pins applied: migration-runner@sha256:def456, schema-tool@sha256:987fed. feature flag set to OFF in prod.

linda: logging note: please ensure backfill.chunk_id and index.phase are in logs. mel, can you add a small synthetic write load during canary to stress test locks?

mel: yes will run 20 rps synthetic write pattern for 3 minutes on canary tenants starting at unpause. will monitor 1s p99 write latency.

db-admin: escape-hatch implemented: if abort triggered, system will CANCEL ongoing backfill jobs, DROP temp_index_* if present, and mark rollout as FAILED. if DROP fails, alert db-admin group immediately.

ops-bot: preflight result: replica_lag=12ms, disk_io=45%, migration_tests=ok, retention headroom ok.

linda: timeline: staging smoke -> preflight pass -> pin images -> manual unpause at 23:20 UTC. final go/no-go at 23:20.

frank: small ask: annotate the unpause message with reason and pointer to this thread so deploybot can link it to the rollout.

sam: +1 as oncall if preflight good. will watch p99.

mel: staging smoke passed, synthetic writes ok. no lock spikes.

linda: GO at 23:20 UTC - unpausing canary.

deploybot: canary unpaused; starting on shards [5,6,7]. pausing after 5th shard.

deploybot: shard 5 complete - median chunk 9s, p99 write latency 88ms, no lock durations >200ms.

mel: synthetic load looks stable, p99 under threshold.

deploybot: paused at canary checkpoint. awaiting manual continue.

linda: continuing rollout to full after manual check.

deploybot: automated ramp to 100% underway. reporting status every 2m.

deploybot: progress: 35% - no errors, temp index sizes within expected.

ops-bot: monitoring note: small transient retry spike at 41% ramp (0.6% writes) - resolved after lowering batch size to 2k rows/min.

db-admin: confirmed no metadata locks exceeded 500ms during index rename windows.

deploybot: rollout completed to 100%. final status: SUCCESS. total elapsed 21m.

mel: pulling final metrics for release notes. will add short blurb: "Partial index v2: reduced on-disk temp footprint; controlled ramp and escape hatch."

linda: thanks all - leaving thread open for 1h in case of delayed issues. good job. :party_parrot:
